title: 肩甲骨引き寄せ
steps: 椅子に浅く座る
ひじを軽く曲げて後ろへ引く
肩甲骨を背骨に寄せて2秒キープ
pose_en: sitting on a chair, elbows bent at her sides, pulling them back to squeeze her shoulder blades together toward the spine

title: 首の前倒し
steps: 両手を後頭部に軽く添える
うなずくように頭を前に倒す
首の後ろの伸びを感じて深呼吸
pose_en: sitting, both hands resting gently on the back of her head, tilting her head forward to stretch the back of her neck

title: 首の回旋ストレッチ
steps: 背すじを伸ばして座る
ゆっくり真横を向く
伸びを感じたら反対側も
pose_en: sitting upright, slowly turning her head to look to the side, stretching the side of her neck

title: あご引きエクササイズ
steps: 背すじを伸ばして前を向く
あごを水平に後ろへ引く
2秒キープして戻す
pose_en: sitting upright facing forward, tucking her chin straight back (chin tuck), head aligned over her spine

title: 手首・前腕のストレッチ
steps: 片腕を前に伸ばす
手のひらを上に向ける
反対の手で指先をやさしく引く
pose_en: one arm extended forward with palm up, gently pulling the fingers back with the other hand

title: 壁で胸を開くストレッチ
steps: 壁に前腕をつける
体をゆっくり反対へひねる
胸の前の伸びを感じてキープ
pose_en: standing beside a wall, forearm placed on the wall, rotating her torso away to open and stretch her chest

title: 脇・体側のストレッチ
steps: 椅子に座り片腕を斜め上へ
体をやや横に倒す
脇から体側の伸びを感じる
pose_en: sitting on a chair, one arm raised diagonally overhead, leaning her torso slightly to the side

title: 首すじのストレッチ
steps: 片手を背中に回す
頭を斜め前に倒す
首すじの伸びを感じてキープ
pose_en: sitting, one hand tucked behind her lower back, tilting her head diagonally forward to stretch the side of her neck

title: こめかみほぐし
steps: 両手の指先をこめかみに当てる
やさしく円を描くように動かす
呼吸を止めずに10秒ほど
pose_en: sitting with eyes closed, fingertips of both hands on her temples, massaging in gentle circles

title: 肩回し
steps: 両肩に指先を軽く添える
ひじで大きく円を描く
後ろ回しでゆっくり5回
pose_en: sitting, fingertips resting on her shoulders, rolling her elbows in large backward circles

title: 座ったままツイスト
steps: 椅子に浅く座る
椅子の背に手を添える
上体をゆっくりひねる
pose_en: sitting on a chair, one hand on the backrest, gently twisting her upper body to the side

title: 立って体側伸ばし
steps: 足を腰幅に開いて立つ
両手を頭上で組む
真横にゆっくり倒す
pose_en: standing with feet hip-width apart, hands clasped overhead, bending her torso to the side

title: 椅子で脱力前屈
steps: 椅子に浅く座る
力を抜いて上体を前に倒す
腕は下にだらんと垂らす
pose_en: sitting on a chair, folding her relaxed upper body forward over her thighs, arms hanging loosely down

title: 深呼吸ストレッチ
steps: 背すじを伸ばして座る
片手を胸、片手をお腹に当てる
ゆっくり深呼吸を5回
pose_en: sitting upright with a calm expression, one hand on her chest and one hand on her belly, breathing deeply

title: 立って肩甲骨寄せ
steps: 後ろで手を組む
腕を斜め下に伸ばす
胸を開いて2〜3秒キープ
pose_en: standing, hands clasped behind her back, arms extended downward, chest opened and shoulder blades squeezed together

title: 足首回し
steps: 椅子に座り片脚を浮かせる
足首をゆっくり回す
反対回しも同じように
pose_en: sitting on a chair, one leg lifted slightly off the floor, rotating her ankle in slow circles
